summary: 马来西亚传统民居和中东风塔借通风、遮阳与当地材料调节室温。文章以此反思依赖空调的现代建筑，考察隔热、窗户、太阳能等方案，并指出住房还须适合当地人的生活。

paragraphs.brief: 戴维斯说：“Kampung房屋的建造者“对现代科学或工程学一无所知，但他们提出了完美的设计。”
sentences: The traditional kampung houses of Malaysia do not need air-conditioning.
马来西亚的传统Kampung房屋不需要空调。
Built on stilts and with steep roofs, they have year-round ventilation.
建筑在高楼顶上，有全年的通风。
The raised structure ensures a cooling breeze comes up through the floorboards, while the high roof acts as a chimney to release hot air.
升起的结构确保了风从地板上吹来，而高屋顶则起到烟囱的作用，释放热空气。
The airtight, concrete boxes of modern city construction, in contrast, are heat traps, says Muhammad Peter Davis of University Putra Malaysia.
与马来西亚普特拉大学的Muhammad Peter Davis所言：“密闭的，混凝土箱现代城市的建设。”
He has calculated that typical modern Malaysian houses are 5°C hotter than the air outside.
他计算出马来西亚现代房屋比外面的空气温度高5°C。
The builders of kampung houses “had no knowledge of modern science or engineering but they came up with the perfect design,” says Davis.
戴维斯说：“Kampung房屋的建造者“对现代科学或工程学一无所知，但他们提出了完美的设计。”

paragraphs.brief: 这个古老的建筑精密和现代精神错乱的故事在世界各地反复出现。
sentences: This story of ancient architectural sophistication and modern insanity is repeated around the world.
这个古老的建筑精密和现代精神错乱的故事在世界各地反复出现。

In the name of modernism, people have thrown away architecture designed to cope with the environment in which they live, and adopted house designs originating from cold, northern environments, where the idea is to keep heat in.
以现代主义的名义，人们抛弃了设计来应付他们生活环境的建筑，并采纳了来自寒冷的北方环境的房屋设计，其思想是保持热量。

paragraphs.brief: 曾经，建筑现代化主义者的目的是建造使自然无法存在的结构，并用空调取代。
sentences: Once, the aim of architectural modernists was to build structures that kept nature out and to replace it with air-conditioning.
曾经，建筑现代化主义者的目的是建造使自然无法存在的结构，并用空调取代。
Now they are learning that they cannot do that effectively.
现在，他们正在认识到，他们无法有效地做到这一点。
Slowly, they are seeing the benefit of working with nature, rather than against it.
慢慢地，他们看到与自然合作的好处，而不是反对它。
In California, they probably use more power for air-conditioning than anywhere else on Earth.
在加州，他们可能使用更多的电源用于空调超过地球上任何地方。
According to Arthur Rosenfeld from the University of California, what California needs is white paint.
据加州大学的Arthur Rosenfeld说加州需要的是白漆

If Los Angeles painted its roofs white, planted trees to shade buildings, and chose lighter-colored paving, it could reduce city temperatures by 3°C and cut the annual air-conditioning bill by US$170 million a year.
如果洛杉矶把屋顶漆成白色、种树为建筑遮阴，并选用颜色较浅的路面材料，城市气温就有望降低 3 摄氏度，每年还能省下 1.7 亿美元的空调费用。

paragraphs.brief: 现代建筑对能源的使用贪婪。
sentences: Modern buildings are greedy in their use of energy.
现代建筑对能源的使用贪婪。
Much is made of the contribution of transportation to global warming, through its emissions of greenhouse gases.
运输通过排放温室气体，对全球变暖作出了很大贡献。
But, globally, transportation is responsible for just 22 per cent of carbon dioxide emissions.
但是，在全球范围，运输仅占二氧化碳排放量的22%。
The building sector is responsible for 31 per cent, mostly the result of heating and air-conditioning systems.
建筑部门占31%，主要是供暖和空调系统造成的。

In developing countries, where demand for electricity for buildings is rising by 5 per cent a year, the biggest demand is for air-conditioning in modern buildings which are often designed to cope with every different climatic condition.
在发展中国家，对建筑物的电力需求每年增加5%，对现代建筑物的空调需求最大，这些建筑物的设计往往适应各种不同的气候条件。

paragraphs.brief: 在空调之前，阿拉伯世界大部分地区通过深思熟虑的建筑设计保持了冷静。
sentences: Before air-conditioning, much of the Arab world kept cool through thoughtful building design.
在空调之前，阿拉伯世界大部分地区通过深思熟虑的建筑设计保持了冷静。
Many buildings were built according to the principles of the wind tower, a tall structure with vertical vents at the top that open in all directions to catch any passing breeze.
许多建筑物是根据风塔的原则建造的，高楼顶上有垂直喷口，向所有方向开放，以捕捉任何顺风。
Typically, these wind-tower buildings were made of local materials such as stone, mud brick, wood and palm-tree fronds.
通常，这些风塔建筑是由当地材料，如石块、泥砖、木头和棕榈树花纹制成的。

The buildings were inward-looking, which served the dual function of focusing attention on the courtyard, where family members spend time together, and protecting living areas from the rays of the sun.
这些建筑物是内向的，发挥双重功能，即集中关注院子，家庭成员在那里共度时间，保护生活区不受阳光的照射。

paragraphs.brief: 今天，在整个中东，风塔往往只是博物馆的物品而已。
sentences: Throughout the Middle East today, wind towers are often little more than museum pieces.
今天，在整个中东，风塔往往只是博物馆的物品而已。
But there are exceptions.
但也有例外。
Jordan has won awards for the architecture of a village on the shores of the Red Sea, which is designed to conserve energy.
约旦为红海沿岸一个村庄的建筑赢得了奖项，该村旨在节约能源。

Made of rough, local stone in a traditional style, it combines the ventilation system of the wind towers for summer coolness with up-to-date heating and floor insulation to protect against the desert cold in winter.
由粗糙的当地石块制成传统风格它把风塔的通风系统与最新的暖气和地板隔热结合起来以防冬天的沙漠寒冷

paragraphs.brief: 此外，粘土是绝佳的隔热剂，可以冷酷地对外部热量进行隔热，而且很容易回收。
sentences: Traditional building materials, like traditional building designs, are being rediscovered by those looking for low-energy solutions to the current construction needs.
传统的建筑材料，像传统的建筑设计一样，正在被那些寻求低能源解决办法以满足目前建筑需求的人重新发现。

Clay is one such material: As the Dutch housing contractor R van der Ley has argued in promoting a series of clay housing projects in developing countries, clay has many benefits over its industrialized version, brick.
Clay就是这样一种材料：荷兰住房承包商R van der Ley在推动发展中国家一系列粘土住房项目时指出，粘土比其工业化版“砖”有许多好处。
Clay blocks cost only half as much as ordinary bricks.
Clay区块只花了普通砖块的一半
Clay also generates work because people can find it, mould it, bake it and work it themselves.
Clay还创造工作因为人们可以找到它，塑造它，烤它并自己工作。
Two hundred clay bricks can be made with the fuel oil that makes just one ordinary brick.
两百块粘土砖可以用油制成油只制造一块普通砖
Moreover, clay is an excellent insulator against both cold and heat outside, and can easily be recycled.
此外，粘土是绝佳的隔热剂，可以冷酷地对外部热量进行隔热，而且很容易回收。

paragraphs.brief: 1983年，瑞典通过了一项国家标准，要求该国的房屋一年中每平方米损失不超过60千瓦小时。
sentences: But although traditional methods and materials can be revived in appropriate settings, new green, low-energy technologies are needed, especially in urban environments.
但是，尽管传统方法和材料可以在适当环境下恢复，但需要新的绿色低能技术，特别是在城市环境中。
The thermal insulation of homes in cold countries is an example.
寒冷国家住宅的隔热就是一个例子。
In 1983, Sweden adopted a national standard, requiring the country’s homes to lose no more than 60 kilowatt-hours per square metre over the year.
1983年，瑞典通过了一项国家标准，要求该国的房屋一年中每平方米损失不超过60千瓦小时。
To meet that standard, windows were double-glazed, and walls and roofs insulated.
为了达到这一标准，窗户被双层玻璃隔开，墙壁和屋顶被隔绝。
Every home became a fortress against the cold air outside.
每个家都变成一个堡垒对抗外面的寒冷空气
Unfortunately, the rest of Europe has not followed the lead.
不幸的是，欧洲其他国家没有带头。

paragraphs.brief: 在美国，Amory Lovins推广了一系列低能技术：“超级窗口”，例如，这些技术让无形的光线进入，但可以“调整”以允许或反射红外太阳辐射——即热的东西。
sentences: In the United States, Amory Lovins has promoted a range of low-energy technologies: “super-windows”, for example, which let in invisible light but can be “tuned” to either allow in, or reflect away, infrared solar radiation — the stuff that heats.
在美国，Amory Lovins推广了一系列低能技术：“超级窗口”，例如，这些技术让无形的光线进入，但可以“调整”以允许或反射红外太阳辐射——即热的东西。
Buildings with large expanses of window (and big energy bills) can be designed to achieve optimum temperatures.
可以设计大面积窗户(和大能源费)的建筑物，以达到最佳温度。

paragraphs.brief: 除了更有效地利用能源之外，世界还需要新的可再生能源。
sentences: As well as more efficient use of energy, the world also needs new sources of renewable power.
除了更有效地利用能源之外，世界还需要新的可再生能源。
Solar energy is being tried out in the developing world, in villages often far from electricity grids.
太阳能在发展中国家，在往往远离电网的村庄，正在尝试开发。
The world’s biggest solar power installation got underway in the Philippines, in 2001, where a project commenced to install solar panels for 400,000 people in 150 villages.
世界上最大的太阳能发电装置于2001年在菲律宾启动，该项目开始在150个村庄为40万人安装太阳能电池板。
Such projects are demonstrating that countries, whether developing or developed, no longer need huge national grids to supply electricity.
这些项目表明，无论是发展中国家还是发达国家，不再需要庞大的国家电网来供电。
Every home can do its own thing with the help of a solar panel and a storage battery.
每个家庭都可以在太阳能电池板和储存电池的帮助下做自己的事。

paragraphs.brief: 当然，房屋不仅仅是住的机器。
sentences: Houses, of course, are more than machines for living in.
当然，房屋不仅仅是住的机器。
They are social and psychological spaces, too.
它们也是社会和心理空间。
Future houses may not look exactly like kampungs or wind towers or any other traditional models.
未来的房屋可能不完全像Kampungs或风塔或任何其他传统模式。
But to work for us and for our environment, they will have to suit us as well as these traditional forms did.
但是，为了为我们和我们的环境工作，它们必须像这些传统形式一样适合我们。

items.en: reasons why a particular construction material is advantageous
items.zh: 特定建筑材料有利的原因
items.why: 题干要“为什么这种材料有优势"。第 G段集中罗列 clay (黏土) 的优点成本、就业、能耗、隔热、可回收),完全对应。

items.en: an example of a construction design which benefits domestic interaction
items.zh: 有利于国内互动的建筑设计实例
items.why: 关键词是 domestic interaction。只有第E段明确写到“家人一起相处”的空间设计 (courtyard)。

items.en: a description of a house that is ventilated from below
items.zh: 描述从下面通风的房屋
items.why: “from below”=从下方进风。这里明确“comes up through the floorboards”,精准对应。

items.en: an example of self-sufficient energy supply
items.zh: 自给自足能源供应的范例
items.why: 题干找“self-sufficient”。这句话直接总结“每家自供电”,最匹配。

items.en: suggested methods of reducing temperatures in a city
items.zh: 建议降低城市气温的方法
items.why: 题干要求“methods”且针对“city temperatures”。第C段给了三条具体降温措施并说明效果。

items.answer: D · Traditional knowledge can be superior to modern knowledge.
items.solution: 传统知识可以优于现代知识。

items.answer: G · There is a very simple solution that can save on the cost of air-conditioning.
items.solution: 有一个非常简单的解决方案可以节省空调费用。

items.answer: A · The choice of a certain construction material can have a socio-economic impact.
items.solution: 选择某种建筑材料可产生社会经济影响。

items.answer: E · There is an innovation that can save costs on both air-conditioning and heating.
items.solution: 有一项创新可以节省空调和供暖的费用。

items.en: The air temperature in modern Malaysian houses is lower than the air temperature outside.
items.zh: 现代马来西亚房屋的空气温度低于外面的空气温度。
items.why: 典型马来西亚现代住宅的室内温度比室外高约五摄氏度，和“更低”相反。

items.en: The construction industry is more to blame than transport for global warming.
items.zh: 建筑业比运输业更受全球暖化的责备。
items.why: 文中给建筑部门的占比为31%，交通为22%；以这两个部门比较，建筑所占份额更高。

items.en: The use of wind towers for cooling is widespread in the Middle East today.
items.zh: 今天，在中东广泛使用风塔进行冷却。
items.why: 中东如今的许多风塔只相当于博物馆展品，并没有普遍用于降温。

items.en: The ‘super-windows’ promoted by Amory Lovins can be installed at low cost.
items.zh: Amory Lovins所提倡的“超级窗口”可以低成本地安装。
items.why: 原文介绍“超级窗”的采光、隔热等特性，但没有说安装成本高或低。

points: 题干找“self-sufficient”。这句话直接总结“每家自供电”,最匹配。
原文介绍“超级窗”的采光、隔热等特性，但没有说安装成本高或低。
clauses: The raised structure ensures a cooling breeze comes up through the floorboards, ….
连接词 while 引出“while the high roof acts as a chimney to release hot air”，说明主句的时间或对比关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 while 把这一层关系补进去。
“that typical modern Malaysian houses are 5°C hotter than the air outside”补足 calculated 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 calculated 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
lead: New ideas and some old ones
新的想法和一些旧的想法
